Name: Refresh Token Renewal Job
Author: admin

Parameters.Description: The integration environments for which to update the refresh tokens. This parameter accepts multiple values as comma-separated string. To configure this parameter, enclose every environment name in “” double quotes, such as “Default environment”, “Environment 1”, “Environment 5”.
The connector names for which to update the refresh tokens. This parameter accepts multiple values as comma-separated string. To configure an individual value, enclose it in double quotes.

Description: Token renewal job should be used to periodically update the refresh token configured for the integration. By default, the refresh token expires every 90 days, making integration unusable upon expiration. It is recommended to run this job every 7 or 14 days to make sure that refresh token will be up to date.
